caption: The drawing shows a single metal object, rendered in grayscale pencil or charcoal, positioned diagonally on a plain, light-colored background. The object consists of three solid legs, two of which curve outward at the base and support the structure at the front while the third extends horizontally backward in a straight line. At the front, the vertical element rises upward and curves at the top, ending in a hexagonal or faceted protrusion. Near the intersection of the curved vertical element and the backward-extending horizontal arm, there is a prominent, similarly faceted bolt or knob. The texture and shading emphasize the metallic, rough surface of the object, and the drawing focuses solely on the object without any surrounding details or background elements.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
